summary: SF_TRIM_NC_STAIN_v1 draft artifacts (spec.json, research.json, resolution.json, materials.json, sop_modules.json, production.json) pass all critical validation checks. 33 tasks thread correctly between sop_modules.json and production.json. All IDs use TRST prefix. coating_type dimension correctly gates module activation. Design spec Section 11 validation criteria verified. No blockers. 3 minor notes for future consideration.

issues.description: TSK_TRST_STAIN_COAT_2_APPLY uses a blended rate (100 LF/hr) rather than method-specific rates. In practice, coat 2 rate should vary by method (brush vs roll vs spray) like coat 1.
issues.suggested_fix: Consider splitting into method-specific coat 2 tasks in future iteration if rate differentiation is needed.

issues.description: Sealer and clear coat rates shown are for brush method. Spray rates noted in rate_basis_notes but not as separate task entries. Engine may need method-aware rate lookup for sealer tasks.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable for initial draft. If engine needs explicit spray rates for sealer, add separate sealer spray task entries.

issues.description: 5 registry additions proposed (1 SF_, 2 substrate states, 2 enum dimensions). These must be added to controlled_enums.json and id_registry.json before spec can be imported to database.
issues.suggested_fix: Add proposed IDs during database import phase.

checks.details: MOD_TRST_STAIN_APPLY and MOD_TRST_STAIN_COAT_2 have applies_when coating_type=[stain_clear, stain_only]. MOD_TRST_CLEAR_APPLY has applies_when coating_type=[stain_clear, clear_only]. MOD_TRST_CONDITION requires coating_type includes stain. MOD_TRST_STAIN_DRY requires stain_clear only.

checks.check: stain_clear variant has independent stain/clear application methods
checks.details: spec.json has separate application_method_stain (brush/roll/spray) and application_method_clear (brush/spray) dimensions. Variants show independent combos (e.g., VAR_TRST_QT4_STAIN_CLEAR_ROLL_SPRAY).

checks.check: clear_only excludes stain modules and blocks roll
checks.details: clear_only does NOT appear in stain module applies_when. application_method_clear has values [brush, spray] — no roll. Roll explicitly prohibited in design spec and clear_sheen dimension notes.

checks.check: stain_only excludes sealer and clear modules
checks.details: stain_only does NOT appear in sealer or clear module applies_when. MOD_TRST_SEALER_APPLY requires coating_type=[stain_clear, clear_only]. MOD_TRST_CLEAR_APPLY same.
SYS_STAIN_GEL has qt_gate: [QT4, QT5] in materials.json. COMPAT_TRST_002 rule explicitly blocks gel + QT3.
SYS_CLEAR_LACQUER has application_constraint: spray in materials.json. COMPAT_TRST_003 rule explicitly blocks lacquer + brush.

All 14 MOD_ IDs use MOD_TRST_* prefix. All 33 TSK_ IDs use TSK_TRST_* prefix. Material system IDs (SYS_STAIN_*, SYS_SEALER_*, SYS_CLEAR_*) are correctly shared (no TRST prefix per design spec Section 9).
stain_clear: SS_BARE input → SS_CLEAR_COATED output. stain_only: SS_BARE → SS_STAINED. clear_only: [SS_BARE, SS_STAINED] → SS_CLEAR_COATED. Matches design spec exactly.
MOD_TRST_CONDITION applies_when: wood_species_group=softwood, coating_type includes stain. Module description notes NOT activated for gel stain.

checks.check: Grain-raise prep task conditionally activated for waterborne
checks.details: TSK_TRST_GRAIN_RAISE in MOD_TRST_PREP has applies_when note for waterborne products.

checks.check: User-selectable coat counts with QT defaults
checks.details: spec.json stain_coats default=1, sealer_coats default_by_qt QT3:0/QT4:1/QT5:2, clear_coats default_by_qt QT3:1/QT4:2/QT5:3. All user-overridable per design spec Section 4.6.

checks.check: Production rates calibrated against paint spec counterparts
checks.details: Stain brush (80 LF/hr) matches paint brush coat 1 (80 LF/hr). Clear brush (100 LF/hr) slightly faster than paint brush (due to no wipe). Inspection rates reuse paint tier rates. Sanding rates consistent with paint interstage.

doctrine_checks.details: No geometry computation. All geometry from PaintScope inputs.
All required inputs declared with paintscope_key mappings.
All 33 tasks have unit_of_measure declared (LF, SF, EA, FIXED).
All production rates match task UOM.
All 33 tasks have task_classification defined (25 binary, 8 qt_scaled).
task_classification matches between sop_modules.json and production.json.
All 25 binary tasks have single rate_per_hour or fixed_time_minutes.
All 8 qt_scaled tasks have qt_rates with QT3, QT4, QT5 entries.
3 setup tasks + 1 teardown task have protection_metadata.
Zone IDs floor_perimeter, wall_adjacent, fixture_covers all exist.

prohibited_patterns_checked.details: Valid phases only: setup, prep, apply, interstage, finish, cleanup
Single sheen values: satin, semi-gloss, gloss
All uppercase: LF, SF, EA, ROLL, SHEET, TUBE, QT, FIXED
Categories: applicator, protection, prep, abrasive, fill_material, tool

resolution_to_downstream.context_prefix_TRST: used consistently in all TSK_, MOD_ IDs
resolution_to_downstream.applicable_enums_honored: All enum values in downstream files are within resolution.json applicable_enums
resolution_to_downstream.proposed_registry_additions: 5 additions proposed — need registry update before database import

review_notes: All 33 TSK_ IDs thread correctly between sop_modules.json and production.json
coating_type dimension correctly gates all conditional modules
Material system IDs use shared naming (SYS_STAIN_*, SYS_SEALER_*, SYS_CLEAR_*) — no TRST prefix per design spec
7 paintable items (door casing and window casing excluded — routed to their own stain specs per design spec Section 3)
Profile complexity modifiers (0.85-1.40) consistent with paint counterpart
5 registry additions proposed for controlled_enums.json and id_registry.json
This spec establishes the canonical stain/clear module architecture for all 10 interior stain specs per design spec Section 10
